configContents./etc/mkinitcpio.conf:
# vim:set ft=sh
MODULES=(i915 btrfs)
BINARIES=()
FILES=()
HOOKS=(base systemd autodetect microcode modconf kms keyboard sd-vconsole block sd-encrypt filesystems fsck)
#COMPRESSION="zstd"
configContents./etc/mkinitcpio.conf.pacnew:
# vim:set ft=sh
# MODULES
# The following modules are loaded before any boot hooks are run.
MODULES=()

BINARIES=()

FILES=()

# HOOKS
HOOKS=(base systemd autodetect microcode modconf kms keyboard sd-vconsole block filesystems fsck)

#COMPRESSION="zstd"
#COMPRESSION_OPTIONS=()

configContents./etc/pam.d/kde.pacsave:
#%PAM-1.0
auth       include      system-local-login
account    include      system-local-login
password   include      system-local-login
session    include      system-local-login
configContents./etc/samba/smb.conf:
[global]
   workgroup = WORKGROUP
   server string = nas-01

[homes]
   browseable = no

[Medien]
   path = /mnt/storage/media
   read only = yes
   guest ok = yes

[Fotos]
   path = /mnt/storage/photos
   writable = yes
   valid users = @family

[printers]
   path = /var/spool/samba
   printable = yes
configContents./etc/samba/smb.conf.pacnew:
# This is the main Samba configuration file. See smb.conf(5).
[global]
   workgroup = MYGROUP
   server string = Samba Server
   log file = /var/log/samba/%m.log
configContents./etc/ssh/sshd_config:
Include /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/*.conf
Port 22
PermitRootLogin prohibit-password
AuthorizedKeysFile .ssh/authorized_keys
KbdInteractiveAuthentication no
UsePAM yes
PrintMotd no
Subsystem sftp /usr/lib/ssh/sftp-server
configContents./etc/ssh/sshd_config.pacnew:
# This is the sshd server system-wide configuration file.
Include /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/*.conf
#Port 22
#PermitRootLogin prohibit-password
AuthorizedKeysFile .ssh/authorized_keys
KbdInteractiveAuthentication no
UsePAM yes
PrintMotd no
Subsystem sftp /usr/lib/ssh/sftp-server
